{{Quote|The Republic have set up a ''mining outpost'' here&mdash;in this ''asteroid field'' close to Mirial&mdash;to cope with their ''increased demand'' for tibanna gas.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="In the Air" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained a '''mining outpost''' near [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]], in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was overseen by [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Fivvle]].
